title: What Deep-Space Depot Networks Is
definition: Deep-Space Depot Networks: pre-positioned supply caches across the outer system.
description:
Deep-Space Depot Networks is pre-positioned supply caches across the outer system. It sits squarely in Interstellar & Deep Space Futures, the frontier where cache modules science becomes depot logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are inventory tracking-scale. Societies that master depot hulls early will shape autonomous tending practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why cache modules programs worldwide now treat Deep-Space Depot Networks as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Deep-Space Depot Networks needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Deep-Space Depot Networks
title: Real Research Today: Deep-Space Depot Networks
definition: Today's documented research behind Deep-Space Depot Networks.
description:
The road to Deep-Space Depot Networks is already being paved. CERN's antimatter research (ALPHA, AEgIS) studies antimatter properties relevant to far-future propulsion physics. Project Hyperion ran an international design competition for crewed generation-ship concepts.

NASA's Kilopower/KRUSTY project demonstrated compact fission power for deep-space outposts. Together these programs form the cache modules foundation that Deep-Space Depot Networks will build on — the depot logistics results, the autonomous tending methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as depot logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2032 — First long-duration inventory tracking testbed runs a sealed dep
title: 2032 — First long-duration inventory tracking testbed runs a sealed dep
definition: 2032 milestone on the Deep-Space Depot Networks roadmap.
description:
First long-duration inventory tracking testbed runs a sealed depot hulls habitat for 1,000 days on Earth, proving the cache modules recycling math.

What must be true first: the cache modules results have to replicate outside the lab, depot logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and autonomous tending operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed cache modules demonstrations, depot logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting autonomous tending uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Deep-Space Depot Networks
definition: Estimates Deep-Space Depot Networks readiness from component maturity.

Honest scoring is the point: a depot hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Deep-Space Depot Networks Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Deep-Space Depot Networks operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Deep-Space Depot Networks installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 7055 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where cache modules monitoring, depot logistics redundancy, or autonomous tending maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Deep-Space Depot Networks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Deep-Space Depot Networks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Deep-Space Depot Networks — pre-positioned supply caches across the outer system.

Phase 1 — Prove (cache modules): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (depot logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (autonomous tending): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (inventory tracking): depot hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and outer system-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
